summary_zh: HyperFrames 是开源框架，可将 HTML、CSS、媒体和可定位动画转换为确定性 MP4 视频。支持通过 CLI 本地使用、借助 AI 编程代理的技能，或作为托管创作流程的渲染核心。
audience_zh: 适合使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的视频创作者，也适合通过 CLI 本地制作视频的开发者。需要 Node.js 22+ 和 FFmpeg。

evidence.quote: HyperFrames is a free, open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. Use it locally with the CLI, from AI coding agents with skills, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
Using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another coding agent? Run `npx hyperframes skills update` once, then ask your agent to make a video.
